name: T01

theorem T01 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeTr Scope.Model.trJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N

author: private-claude
name: T04
source:
theorem T04 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S := by
  intro m N M hdet hDu hDv hM hN hlt
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hS
  have hS' : m.S ≤ 0 := by omega
  have e : m.modeDet N M = M*M*m.detJ - M*N*m.S + N*N*(m.Du*m.Dv) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have h1 : 0 < M*M*m.detJ := Int.mul_pos (Int.mul_pos hM hM) hdet
  have h2 : 0 ≤ M*N*(-m.S) := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) hN) (by omega)
  have h3 : 0 ≤ N*N*(m.Du*m.Dv) := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg hN hN) (Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega))
  have h4 : M*N*(-m.S) = -(M*N*m.S) := by grind
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S

author: private-claude
name: T05
source:
theorem T05 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M h hM hN hS _
  have key : m.modeDet N M = m.detJ * (M * M) - N * (m.S * M) + N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have h1 : 0 < m.detJ * (M * M) := Int.mul_pos h (Int.mul_pos hM hM)
  have h2 : N * (m.S * M) ≤ N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N) := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS hN
  rw [key]
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M

author: private-claude
name: T06
source:
theorem T06 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h6 : m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N := Int.not_lt.mp h
  have h7 := T05 m N M h1 h2 h3 h6 h4
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M

author: private-claude
name: T07
source:
theorem T07 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) := by
  intro m p s hd hp hDD hS n hn
  have sq : ∀ x : Int, x ^ 2 = x * x := by
    intro x; simp [Int.pow_succ]
  have h1 : 0 < Scope.modeM p := by
    unfold Scope.modeM
    rw [sq]; exact Int.mul_pos hp hp
  have h2 : 0 ≤ Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    exact Int.mul_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) (Int.sq_nonneg _)
  have hn1 : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) := by omega
  have hn2 : (1:Int) * 1 ≤ (n:Int) * n := Int.mul_le_mul hn1 hn1 (by omega) (by omega)
  have hn3 : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) ^ 2 := by
    rw [sq]; omega
  have hs : 0 ≤ s ^ 2 := Int.sq_nonneg s
  have h3 : s ^ 2 * 1 ≤ s ^ 2 * (n:Int) ^ 2 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn3 hs
  have h4 : m.Du * m.Dv * (s ^ 2 * 1) ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * (s ^ 2 * (n:Int) ^ 2) :=
    Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hDD
  have h5 : m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * (Scope.modeN s n) := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    rw [Int.mul_comm ((n:Int) ^ 2) (s ^ 2)]
    rw [Int.mul_one] at h4
    exact h4
  have key : m.S * Scope.modeM p ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeM
    exact Int.le_trans hS h5
  have := T05 m (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) hd h1 h2 key hDD
  exact Int.le_of_lt this
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p)

author: private-claude
name: T08
source:
theorem T08 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M hP hS
  have h1 : m.modeDet N M = m.detJ*M^2 - m.S*M*N + (m.Du*m.Dv)*N^2 := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have h2 : 0 ≤ (2*(m.Du*m.Dv)*N - m.S*M)^2 + (4*(m.Du*m.Dv)*m.detJ - m.S^2)*M^2 :=
    Int.add_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) (Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (Int.sq_nonneg _))
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h3 : 0 < (4*(m.Du*m.Dv)) * (-(m.modeDet N M)) := Int.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  have h4 : (4*(m.Du*m.Dv)) * (-(m.modeDet N M)) = -((2*(m.Du*m.Dv)*N - m.S*M)^2 + (4*(m.Du*m.Dv)*m.detJ - m.S^2)*M^2) := by
    rw [h1]
    grind
  rw [h4] at h3
  first | omega | grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M

name: T09
source:
theorem T09 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  refine ⟨T04 m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6, ?_⟩
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h7 : m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ := Int.not_lt.mp h
  have h8 := T08 m N M (Int.mul_pos h2 h3) h7
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2

name: T10

theorem T10 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N := by
  intro m N M hM hN hD hneg
  have e : m.modeDet N M = M*M*m.detJ - M*N*m.S + N*N*(m.Du*m.Dv) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have h0 : 0 ≤ N*N*(m.Du*m.Dv) := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg hN hN) hD
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h2 : m.S * N ≤ m.detJ * M := by omega
  have h3 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (Int.le_of_lt hM)
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N

author: private-claude
name: T11
source:
theorem T11 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2 := by
  intro m p s hdet hp hDD hex
  obtain ⟨n, hn, h⟩ := hex
  have hn1 : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) := by omega
  have hn2 : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int)^2 := by
    have := Int.mul_le_mul hn1 hn1 (by omega) (by omega)
    simpa [Int.pow_succ] using this
  have hs : 0 ≤ s^2 := Int.sq_nonneg s
  have hp2 : 0 < p^2 := by
    have := Int.mul_pos hp hp
    simpa [Int.pow_succ] using this
  have hN : 0 ≤ Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    exact Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) hs
  have hM : 0 < Scope.modeM p := by
    unfold Scope.modeM
    exact hp2
  have h6 := T06 m (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) hdet hM hN hDD h
  unfold Scope.modeN Scope.modeM at h6
  have hk : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s^2 := Int.mul_nonneg hDD hs
  have h7 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn2 hk
  have eq : m.Du * m.Dv * ((n:Int)^2 * s^2) = (m.Du * m.Dv * s^2) * (n:Int)^2 := by grind
  rw [eq] at h6
  rw [Int.mul_one] at h7
  exact Int.lt_of_le_of_lt h7 h6
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2

author: private-claude
name: T12
source:
theorem T12 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M) := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7
  unfold Scope.Hurwitz
  constructor
  · rw [T01]
    have a : m.trJ * M < 0 := Int.mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h1 h5
    have b : 0 ≤ (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) h6
    omega
  · exact T05 m N M h2 h5 h6 h7 (Int.le_of_lt (Int.mul_pos h3 h4))
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M)
